name: proworks-engine-suite
description: ForgeIQ, CostIQ, Prime, and ReceiptIQ — portable intelligence engines. Hosts consume them; they depend on no host.
author: Steven Kreutzer

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/forgeiq packages/costiq packages/prime packages/receiptiq
